name: Last Pee Standing 🚽
desc:
Can you survive… before it’s too late?

This is a fast-paced survival game where your only goal is to find a toilet before time runs out!
Each round gets more intense—search the map, use items wisely, and survive every round to prove yourself.

💥 Game Features
・Search for a toilet before the timer hits zero
・Survive round after round of increasing chaos
・Use items strategically to stay alive
・Outsmart other players and avoid elimination
・Become the one and only Toilet King 👑

Do you have what it takes to survive till the end…
or will you fail to find a toilet in time?
